circuit.name: Interleaved Multiphase Buck DC-DC Converter
circuit.description: Four-phase interleaved synchronous buck converter for high-current CPU/GPU core power delivery. Converts 12V input to 1.2V output. All phases run at 500kHz with 90 degrees phase offset (tdelay = k*T/4 on phase k+1) for output ripple cancellation. Each phase uses an NMOS high-side switch with a floating gate drive (referenced to its switch node) and an NMOS synchronous low-side switch with 40ns dead time. The shared output capacitor benefits from interleaved ripple cancellation.

requirements.requirement: Output voltage regulation at 1.2V; verify interleaved ripple cancellation achieves < 5mV ripple

data.name: Vout_ripple_vpp
data.description: Peak-to-peak output ripple (should be cancelled by interleaving)

requirements.requirement: Current sharing balance between the four phases; verify IL1_avg = IL2_avg = IL3_avg = IL4_avg = Iout/4

outputs.description: Current sharing imbalance percentage (max - min vs. ideal per-phase current)

requirements.requirement: Efficiency and per-phase loss breakdown
